Workbench.NoCatalogDescription: No description was supplied by the catalog.
Workbench.DomainServicesFailed: Related service evidence could not be read

Workbench.OwnedServicesHelp: Registrations that report this subdomain as their owner.
Workbench.NoOwnedServices: No captured service reports this subdomain as its owner.
Workbench.DependentServicesHelp: Observed services whose roles or domains own collected API calls to this domain. This does not prove execution.
Workbench.NoDependentServices: No observed external service owns a collected caller to this domain.

Workbench.CurrentHostScope: Inspect this host’s identity, registration evidence and local election state alongside the application’s provider lease.
Workbench.LastSuccessfulCapture: The last successful capture remains visible below.
Workbench.LocalTimes: Event timestamps are shown in local time.
Workbench.LocalElectionScope: Local election state belongs to the querying host. It is independent of the provider’s current application leader lease.
Workbench.LeaseScope: Provider lease for this application at capture time. Its reported leader time can advance during renewal.
Workbench.NoLeaderLease: No leader lease was present in the successful provider read.
Workbench.MetadataScope: Metadata exposed by this host at capture time.
Workbench.NoCurrentHostCaptureHelp: Refresh to read this host and its application’s provider lease.
Workbench.FrozenServiceHelp: This inspector retains the selected service read. Directory polling does not replace its registration or metadata evidence.
Workbench.InstanceEvidenceScope: Leadership badges reflect the captured registration heartbeat. Disappearances are observations made by this UI, rather than provider eviction records.
Workbench.HeartbeatInferenceScope: Heartbeat health is evaluated at capture time using the querying host’s heartbeat period and registration TTL. Event timestamps use local time.
Workbench.HeartbeatInferenceFrozenScope: Heartbeat health is evaluated when this inspector freezes the selected read, using the querying host’s heartbeat period and registration TTL. The original read time is unavailable. Event timestamps use local time.
Workbench.ConfigurationScope: These settings belong to the querying host and were captured when the inspector opened. They do not describe the selected remote service’s configuration.
Workbench.IsolationBehaviorCaveat: The current FastShutdown implementation logs isolation and revokes local leadership; it does not stop the host.
Workbench.ForceDeleteScope: Delete the current leader key for application {0}. Membership remains registered, and a host may acquire the lease again on its next heartbeat.
Workbench.LeaderDeleteCaptureUnchanged: The delete completed. This frozen capture remains unchanged; refresh the directory for new provider evidence.
Workbench.ForceDeleteConfirmation: Delete the current leader key for application {0}? This targets the application key even if leadership changed since capture. It does not remove registrations or stop a host, and the lease may be acquired again.
Workbench.CatalogUnavailable: Catalog evidence is unavailable. Refresh to retry; a failed read does not establish that this endpoint is absent.
